# Philippines

The wealth gradients this library holds for Philippines: first the values to give OG-Core, then the measurements behind them. New to the terms? See the [glossary](../glossary.md).

## What to use in OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Tilt | From |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | **by age**, table below (fertility tilt −0.99 plus the [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md)) | DHS 2022 |
| `infmort_gradient` | **−1.60** | DHS 2022 |
| `mort_gradient` | **−0.76** (ages 15–60) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GNI $4,450 per person (~2024) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not covered by this library | — |

Every value is a **tilt** ([what that is](../glossary.md#tilt)). Convert it before passing it to OG-Core: `tilt / (100 × (1 − p))`, with p OG-Core's own rate at that age ([how](../methods/ogcore-units.md)).

**Fertility tilt by mother's age** (for `fert_gradient`; ages under 15 take the 15–19 value, 50 and over the 45–49 value):

| 15–19 | 20–24 | 25–29 | 30–34 | 35–39 | 40–44 | 45–49 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| −1.76 | −1.09 | −0.78 | −0.66 | −0.89 | −1.38 | −1.97 |

## Where these numbers come from

### Household surveys (DHS)

Latest survey, from [`data/gradient_library_latest.csv`](../../data/gradient_library_latest.csv). Earlier surveys are in `gradient_library.csv`.

| Measure | Survey | Tilt | Poorest-to-richest ratio | Poorest fifth → richest fifth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Births per woman (TFR) | 2022 | **−0.99** | 2.2 | 3.1 · 2.2 · 2 · 1.5 · 1.4 |
| Infant deaths per 1,000 births (IMR) | 2022 | **−1.60** | 3.6 | 24 · 17 · 23 · 11 · 6 |
| Under-5 deaths per 1,000 births (U5MR) | 2022 | **−1.76** | 4.1 | 35 · 23 · 25 · 13 · 8 |

## Notes

- No census household-deaths module is available, so there is no measured adult-mortality gradient; use the general gradient (worked value in the table above). The DHS rows (NDHS 2022) cover fertility and child mortality directly.
